# D4 · Cloud and data gatekeepers

**Scope.** Hyperscale cloud, search, app stores, data brokers and credit bureaus: control points over data, distribution and switching; privacy enforcement; interoperability and egress.

## Standing questions

- Where do cloud providers hold equity in the AI developers that are their largest customers?
- What enforcement or market investigations target search, app-store, cloud or data-broker conduct?
- Which data gatekeepers generate the most documented consumer complaints, and how do they respond?

## Watched entities

Microsoft, Alphabet / Google, Amazon / AWS, Meta Platforms, Oracle, CoreWeave, Nebius Group, Apple, IBM, Salesforce, Snowflake, Palantir Technologies, Equinix, Digital Realty, Equifax, TransUnion, Experian
